Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that Greyhound Canada ceased operations in 2018 (2018 marked the discontinuation of western routes; the full shutdown occurred in 2021). This led to unnecessary focus on current operations instead of simply identifying the Greyhound departure location in Toronto—the Toronto Coach Terminal—causing drift from the required answer.
